description: We are group of hackers with different backgrounds in multiple engineering discipline. Our objective is to expand the boundary in our interdisciplinary experience and execution.
summary: It is not easy to balance maintaining resources within a budget for most space organisations. Therefore, we developed an interactive resource management simulation game. It allows users to conduct mission research and planning, managing limited resources, perform base maintenance, and conduct tasks assigned by missions. It trains junior astronauts to manage limited resources and time depending on the given task, mission, and project.
details: It will run a 2D pixel game that simulate how an astronaut manage their limited resources and supply in a limited time while completing missions. The benefits of the game is it is able to help people that have interest in how an astronaut manage resource while doing research on Moon. The tools we used was Godot game engine and Claude AI. Coding language we used was GDScript. Laptop was mainly used when developing the game. Our game project is creative in terms of graphics and atmosphere, where we give a clean pixel art style with suitable space theme and simple objects while still providing space mission simulation. When creating this game, we considered that a game is more suitable to teach the public including space enthusiast and junior astronauts to learn how space mission is done in an environment that lets them explore prior actual training.
